name: Singpass
why: Government identity. Bank KYC, ICA, IRAS, HDB. Register the day your FIN is active.

name: SimplyGo
why: MRT/bus fares, monthly pass, trip history. Or just tap a contactless bank card.

name: Grab
why: Taxis, food, courier. The default. ComfortDelGro app is often cheaper for street cabs.

name: Google Maps / Citymapper
why: MRT is the spine. Maps is accurate; Citymapper is nicer for mixed trips.

name: PayNow (in your bank app)
why: Instant SGD to a mobile number. This is how rent split and dinner bills work.

name: IRAS myTax
why: File after year 1. Most EP holders are tax residents after 183 days.

name: HealthHub / hospital apps
why: Public-cluster records if you use polyclinics. Private groups have their own.

name: NEA myENV
why: PSI/haze, weather, dengue clusters. You will care during haze season.

name: Hawker / Burpple / Google
why: Find the actual stall. Makansutra still matters.

name: Carousell
why: Second-hand furniture, strollers, 'leaving SG' fire sales. The expat cycle in marketplace form.

name: Telegram (All About Singapore / ExpatSG)
why: Events and classifieds still live in Telegram and Facebook groups.

name: MyCareersFuture / LinkedIn
why: Jobs. MyCareersFuture is the government board; LinkedIn is where EP roles actually sit.
